# Depth and Reinforcement Learning in Embodied Scenarios

This directory collects tutorial materials for the reproduction of reinforcement learning, imitation learning, and deep learning in embodied scenarios. It is recommended that you first understand the task boundaries and simulation platforms, before moving on to specific code and training commands.

## Chapter Entry

- [ Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Robot Furniture Grabbing Policy ](01-reinforcement-learning-for-multi-robot-furniture-handling.md): An introduction to the cooperative humanoid robot carrying task of CooHOI.
- [ Simulation Reproduction of HIMLoco quadruped robot motion control in Isaac Lab ](02-himloco-isaaclab-reproduction/README.md): Understanding from the paper, troubleshooting the old Isaac Gym stack, to the new Isaac Lab stack smoke test.
- [ Reproduction of AGILE humanoid robot Loco-Manipulation in Isaac Lab ](03-agile-humanoid-robot-loco-manipulation-reproduction/README.md): Understanding the RL workflow of AGILE humanoid robots, official task boundaries, local Isaac Sim 5.1 replica video, and evaluation export pipeline.
- [ Guide on Reward Alignment for Robots That Know What to Ask ](04-robots-that-know-what-to-ask-reward-alignment-introduction/README.md): Analyzing how ASQ identifies under-specification reward features during teaching and explains how to guide humans to supplement corrective demonstrations using natural language.
- [ Reinforcement Learning for Open Duck Mini and Microduck bipedal robots ](05-open-duck-mini-and-microduck-biped-rl/README.md): Distinguishing the two generations of duck robot models, completing URDF/STL asset download, walking and kicking ball PPO training, ONNX export, RDK policy inference, and MuJoCo WebAssembly browser deployment pipelines.
- [ Reusable score matching motion prior in SMP ](06-smp-reusable-score-matching-motion-priors/README.md): Analyzing how diffusion motion priors transform into PPO rewards through SDS, ESM, Adaptive Normalization, and GSI, and providing the original implementation of MimicKit and the open-source reproduction route for Unitree G1.
- [ Guide on Unified cross-skill dexterous manipulation with UniCross ](07-unicross-unified-cross-skill-agile-manipulation-guide/README.md): Starting from hand-object relationship motion, analyzing the unified observation, actions, and rewards for grasping, moving, hand-internal rotation, and translation, as well as how ten PPO experts can be distilled into a single cross-skill strategy using DAgger.
- [ Human-robot collaborative reinforcement learning with HIL-SERL and MuJoCo socket ](08-hil-serl-human-machine-reinforcement-learning-and-mujoco-jack/README.md): Illustrating intervention actions, double replay buffer, and actor/learner, and learning the data collection, training, and socket task transplantation process through official Panda simulation simulation.

## Learning Recommendations

If you are new to reinforcement learning for robots, it is recommended to first read the HIMLoco section to understand the basic concepts of proprioception, privileged critic, and sim-to-real; then conduct a smaller-scale bipedal training exercise using Open Duck Mini/Microduck with clearer assets and commands; next, study SMP to learn how to freeze the action diffusion model into a reusable motion prior reward; after that, examine UniCross to understand why unified task formulation allows multiple contact skills to share the same policy; finally, look at the AGILE section to learn about more comprehensive humanoid robot task configurations, teacher-student distillation, evaluation reports, and the Sim2MuJoCo review process. Students interested in VLA, post-training world model, or human demonstration data can continue with Robots That Know What to Ask, focusing on understanding reward misalignment, under-specification features, and human-in-the-loop reward correction.
